summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Threat Chronicles MVP. All 12 backend pytest cases passed (100%). Frontend flows (home, language toggle + localStorage, /attacks list of 8 + filters + search, /attacks/log4j detail with narrative/IOCs/lessons, AI Assistant panel with Claude Sonnet 4.5 for 'WannaCry 2017' rendering Turkish narrative + timeline + kill chain, Submit form success toast + reset) all working end-to-end.

minor.issue: Default status filter is 'approved' — a plain GET /api/submissions won't return newly created pending items unless caller passes status=pending or status=all. Might be intentional but easy to misuse for admin UIs.

issues: React hydration console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Caused by the preview instrumentation wrapping the text inside <option> with a <span data-ve-dynamic>. Warning is benign but pollutes console. Consider isolating i18n strings for <option> labels so the instrumentation cannot inject a span (e.g. build a static string outside JSX or pass as attribute) if this needs to be cleaned up.

action_items: Optional: address the <option>/<span> hydration warning on /attacks by rendering plain string children in <option> (avoids the preview tooling wrapping the label in a span).
Optional: consider making GET /api/submissions default include 'pending' or return a shape that documents the default filter.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'). Migrate to lifespan handler for future-proofing.

server.py: AI response parsing falls back to {raw, error} with 200 status. Better UX would be a non-200 code so the frontend error branch triggers; currently frontend does show the parse error via data.error, which works.

AIAssistantPanel.jsx maps AI kill_chain into activity_tr/activity_en using the same string regardless of the requested language — that's actually correct because the backend already returns strings in the requested language, so language is honoured.
Frontend axios calls have no timeout for /ai/analyze — a slow backend could hang the UI indefinitely; add ~60s timeout with a friendly error.
Submit form has no maxLength or length hint for narrative; consider min/max validation on backend Pydantic model.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 8 curated attacks on startup (log4j, solarwinds, wannacry, colonial-pipeline, equifax, notpetya, stuxnet, moveit). Test also created two TEST_ submissions via /api/submissions and the Submit form; they remain in DB with status=pending.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_threat_chronicles.py, executed with pytest (junit at /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml). AI tests need the internet/emergentintegrations key — the Claude endpoint took ~30-60s per call. If the AI test flakes, allow one retry (test_ai_analyze_en already retries once). Frontend Sheet component for AI panel opens off-canvas; use Enter key on ai-input instead of clicking ai-submit-button (submit button sits at x≈1710 in 1920 viewport and Playwright sometimes flags 'outside viewport' before animation completes).
